page.notes: Catchword "folute" is the first word of the next page, printed with the long s as f, so it reads "solute" in this transcription. The rightmost bottom word is set apart from the text and is read as a catchword. The margin reference "sentex, II" is doubtful: the first word is uncertain, and the numeral may be II or 11. The spacing in "minus,ac", "&intrinseca", "&enti" and "&hypotheticam" is copied as printed. The italic passages are judged from the scan and may not be exact. The question number 3 is printed at the head of the question and is kept in the heading.
